name: open-design-agent-kit
description: Open Design for GitHub Copilot: design skills, ready-made design systems, and tools to make, check and export posters, social posts, slides and landing pages. Runs on your computer (needs Node.js).

plugins.name: open-design
plugins.description: Runs the Open Design server on your computer (needs Node.js 18 or later) and saves designs in your workspace. Make posters, social posts, slides, landing pages and prototypes, with ready-made design systems, checks and PDF, PNG or PowerPoint exports.
